candidates.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: alternative transparent RESEARCH ATLAS hero illustration for an academic researcher's existing website, displayed at 300px wide (100px on mobile).
Input image: STYLE AND PALETTE REFERENCE ONLY, not the subject to copy. Match the reference's friendly academic comic inventory-item style: bold dark navy outlines, simplified smooth shapes, clean restrained cel shading. Slight gaming feeling, academically credible, not childish.
Color palette: ocean #285a83, light blue #78a7c9, apricot #eaa05e, ivory #f5ecdd, navy outline #23384d. No gold/metallic finish, no purple or green.

Subject design: A folded ivory research map with ocean-blue map regions and a simple apricot trail linking three navy circular research nodes. A large pocket compass rests on its lower corner, with an apricot needle, and one short navy pencil along the folded map edge. The MAP and COMPASS are the dominant recognizable objects. Three-quarter top view, broad low triangular silhouette. A scholarly exploration kit, no book, no orbital model.
